C0354.title: Company Ordered to Pay 350,000 Yuan for Data Obtained via Credential Stuffing
C0354.summary: The Hangzhou Railway Transport Court heard an unfair competition dispute in which the defendant, Zhejiang C Network Technology Company, obtained data belonging to plaintiffs Hangzhou A Technology Company and Hangzhou B Technology Company through credential stuffing and other improper means. The court ordered the defendant to immediately cease the infringement, pay a total of 350,000 yuan in economic losses to the plaintiffs, and assume civil responsibility for eliminating the impact.

references.title: Obtaining data via 'credential stuffing'—company ordered to pay 350,000 yuan in compensation
